nodes.label: Context Engineering
nodes.rationale: Optimizes agent context setup: curate what the agent sees, when, and how structured. Context is the single biggest lever for agent output quality.

nodes.label: Context Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Five levels: 1) Rules files (always loaded), 2) Spec/architecture docs (per feature), 3) Relevant source files (per task), 4) Error output (per iteration), 5) Conversation history (accumulates, compacts).

nodes.label: Context Budget Management
nodes.rationale: Start trimming at 75% capacity, not 100%. Cut past failures, verbose output, conversational back-and-forth, replaced drafts first. Protect task definition, current error, active file, hard constraints. Compress before dropping.
